drivingQuestion: At what age is one without two hairs deemed an ailonit or saris?
outcomeNote: Mishna records three views without decision

segments.he: מַתְנִי' בַּת עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה שֶׁלֹּא הֵבִיאָה שְׁתֵּי שְׂעָרוֹת — תָּבִיא רְאָיָה שֶׁהִיא בַּת עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה, וְהִיא אַיְילוֹנִית — לֹא חוֹלֶצֶת וְלֹא מִתְיַבֶּמֶת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» A girl twelve years and one day old who grew two pubic hairs is classified as a young woman. Six months later, she becomes a grown woman. But a woman who is «twenty years old who did not grow two» pubic «hairs» and was never classified as a young woman «shall bring proof that she is twenty years old, and» from that point forward «she» assumes the status of «a sexually underdeveloped woman [ailonit],» who is incapable of bearing children. If she married and her husband died childless, «she neither performs ḥalitza nor does she enter into levirate marriage,» as the mitzva of levirate marriage applies only to a woman capable of conceiving a child. An ailonit is excluded from that mitzva.

segments.he: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה שֶׁלֹּא הֵבִיא שְׁתֵּי שְׂעָרוֹת — יָבִיאוּ רְאָיָה שֶׁהוּא בֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה, וְהוּא סָרִיס, לֹא חוֹלֵץ וְלֹא מְיַבֵּם. אֵלּוּ דִּבְרֵי בֵּית הִלֵּל. בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים: זֶה וָזֶה בֶּן שְׁמוֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה.
segments.en: In the case of a man who is «twenty years old who did not grow two» pubic «hairs, they shall bring proof that he is twenty years old and he» assumes the status of «a sexually underdeveloped man [saris],» who is excluded from the mitzva of levirate marriage. Therefore, if his married brother dies childless, «he neither performs ḥalitza nor enters into levirate marriage» with his yevama. «This is the statement of Beit Hillel. Beit Shammai say:» For both «this» case of a woman «and that» case of a man, they shall bring proof that they are «eighteen years old,» and they assume the status of a sexually underdeveloped woman and man respectively.

segments.he: רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: הַזָּכָר — כְּדִבְרֵי בֵּית הִלֵּל, וְהַנְּקֵבָה — כְּדִבְרֵי בֵּית שַׁמַּאי, שֶׁהָאִשָּׁה מְמַהֶרֶת לָבֹא לִפְנֵי הָאִישׁ.
segments.en: «Rabbi Eliezer says:» The status of «the male» is determined «in accordance with the statement of Beit Hillel,» i.e., he assumes the status of a sexually underdeveloped man at the age of twenty; «and» the status of «the female» is determined «in accordance with the statement of Beit Shammai,» i.e., she assumes the status of a sexually underdeveloped woman at the age of eighteen. The reason is «that the woman is quick to reach» physical maturity, and reaches that stage «before the man» reaches physical maturity.
